# `DoctorReport`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Doctor\DoctorReport`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Doctor/DoctorReport.php)

### exitCode()

```php
exitCode(): int
```

0 when healthy; otherwise the CheckCategory::exitCode() of the
FIRST failing check — checks run in diagnosis order, so the first
failure is the root cause (a broken config also breaks the server
build, but the config error is what needs fixing).
